props.text: Area graph: one or several series drawn as filled areas, display only.
Line graph: one or several series drawn as lines, display only.
Donut chart: labelled segments of a ring with a centre total, display only.
Pie chart: labelled segments of a circle, with an optional sunburst ring of subsegments, display only.
Polar chart: sectors of equal angle whose reach shows each value, display only.
Radial bar chart: concentric rings, one for each value, display only.
Horizontal bar: a scale with an optional bar, value fill, advice zones and setpoint marker, display only.
Vertical bar: a scale with an optional bar, value fill, advice zones and setpoint marker, display only.
Circular progress: a ring that fills with a value, or spins while the wait has no end, display only.
Radial instrument: a dial with a needle or filled arc, scale, advice zones and setpoint marker, display only.
Readout block: a number or text with a value, setpoint or advice marker, display only.
